location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: LC-9A has flown 30 launches since its first in 2022, 11 of them this year. Its previous launch was 28 days earlier.
slot_b_text: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
